title: Cosmo: a started install asks the user to say when it finishes, never promises to carry on
description: Cosmo's install_model answer said 'downloading now, tell them so', and Cosmo then promised to run the job once the download finished. Nothing wakes Cosmo when a download ends, so it sat idle. The answer now tells Cosmo to ask the user to let it know when it finishes. Fabio picked this over a wake (2026-10-29).
